name: Saimin Classmate
source:
Nobuhiro Kijo wanted to chat with the cute librarian Yasuko Nonomura, and ended up borrowing a book.
It was a guide to hypnotism.

Why was this sort of book in the school library? he wondered, as he began reading with interest.
When he tested its tactics on Yasuko during their conversation, she fell into a trance... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE096367.html]DLsite English[/url]]
description:
城场信宏想和可爱的图书管理员野野村宁子聊天，结果借了一本书。那是一本催眠术指南。为什么这种书会在学校图书馆里？他疑惑地想着，开始饶有兴趣地阅读。当他在和宁子交谈时对她尝试了书中的技巧时，她陷入了恍惚……
